clue.text: Emotional release of heretic sister

parts.note: the Cathars were a medieval sect condemned as heretics

explanation.surface: A sister who rejected church teaching seems to need some emotional release.
explanation.definitionFit: Catharsis is the purging of pent-up feelings, a standard synonym for emotional release.

clue.text: Distressed copper's taken up to station

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper; the 's stands for has

indicators.note: in a down entry taken up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: to station something is to put it somewhere

explanation.surface: A police officer is upset at being moved to a new station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' looks like a police officer but is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Cut up is an informal British phrase for upset or distressed.

clue.text: Spring baby has a nature that's unruly

indicators.note: something unruly is disorderly, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A baby born in spring has a wild temperament.
explanation.definitionFit: Taurus covers late April to May, so someone born then is a springtime Taurean.

clue.text: A fine story about damsel's end in distress

parts.note: F is the pencil abbreviation for fine

indicators.note: the story goes about the damsel's last letter

parts.note: fiction is a made-up story

indicators.note: the end of damsel is its last letter

explanation.surface: A fairy tale about the fate of a damsel in distress.
explanation.definitionFit: Affliction means suffering or a cause of pain, close to distress.

clue.text: Untreated skin rolled on the tongue

indicators.note: on the tongue means as spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: a ship that rolled swayed from side to side

explanation.surface: Raw hide is rolled around in the mouth, as if being tasted.
explanation.definitionFit: Suede is leather with an unglazed napped surface, a hide left without a finished face.

clue.text: Used civet sprayed around to be alluring

indicators.note: letters sprayed around are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: Civet musk used in perfume is sprayed about to seem attractive.
explanation.walkthrough: Civet, a musky secretion, really was used in perfumes, which helps the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Seductive and alluring are synonyms for attractive and tempting.

clue.text: What refugees did outside I placed on record

indicators.note: the word for what refugees did sits outside the letter I, wrapping it

parts.note: refugees ran away from danger, so they fled

explanation.surface: A clerk recalls an account of fleeing refugees and puts their stories on the record.
explanation.definitionFit: Documents filed have been entered into the records, so placed on record.

clue.text: Resistance when cutting payment on the house

indicators.note: the letter cuts into the payment word, sitting inside it

parts.note: a fee is a payment
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: A homeowner resists paying when told about a fee on their house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the house' looks like a property but is the idiom for no charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on the house is given at no cost, an idiom for gratis.

clue.text: As some popes are showing the nature of pride?

definitions.meaning: thirteen popes took the name Leo, so they are Leos
a pride is a group of lions, so this means lionlike

explanation.surface: A question of whether popes display arrogance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pride' looks like the sin, but it is a group of lions.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means lionlike, and also relates to popes named Leo.

clue.text: Work done on bridge, perhaps damaged its end with crack

indicators.note: damaged letters are broken and rearranged

parts.note: to have a crack is to have a go, a try

explanation.surface: Repairs to a bridge which has a cracked, damaged end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' rearranges ITS END into DENTIS. A dental bridge is false teeth fixed to neighbours.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitting a dental bridge is a job for the dentist, an example of dental work.

clue.text: Fungus beginning to taint nettle

indicators.note: the beginning of the word taint is its first letter

parts.note: to nettle someone is to irritate or ruffle them

explanation.surface: A mushroom forager worries that a stinging plant will spoil the crop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nettle' looks like the plant beside a fungus, but here it is a verb meaning annoy.
explanation.definitionFit: Truffles are prized edible underground fungi.

clue.text: Did individual ingesting Ecstasy become less intense?

indicators.note: the first word swallows the drug's letter, holding it inside

parts.note: taken as written
E is the usual abbreviation for the drug ecstasy
own means individual, peculiar to oneself

explanation.surface: A question about whether someone's high faded after taking a pill.
explanation.definitionFit: To die down is a phrasal verb meaning to subside or weaken gradually.

clue.text: High office with power and official accommodation

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for power
a residency is an official residence, as of an envoy

explanation.surface: A top post comes with clout and a grace-and-favour home.
explanation.definitionFit: The presidency is the office of a president, one of the highest posts in a state.

clue.text: Mother's taken off least skimpy garment

indicators.note: the word for mother is removed from the longer word

parts.note: the minimum is the least amount
mum is a British word for mother; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Mum has removed the barest of outfits, presumably disapproving.
explanation.definitionFit: A mini is a very short skirt or dress, so a skimpy item of clothing.

clue.text: Re-offender ends restraint before queen

parts.note: the backs are the rear ends of things
as in keep a lid on it, a restraint
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A criminal comes to the end of restraint before the queen in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A backslider relapses into bad ways, so is one who offends again.

clue.text: Unfortunately, I can't stop doing that!

indicators.note: things gone unfortunately have gone wrong, so the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone confesses regretfully that they are unable to quit a habit.
explanation.definitionFit: Can it is a slang imperative telling someone to be quiet or quit what they are doing.

clue.text: Perhaps pack instrument for player on the fiddle

parts.note: a pack is an example of cards
a harp is a musical instrument

explanation.surface: A musician packs an instrument, perhaps for a violinist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddle' looks like a violin; 'on the fiddle' means cheating.
explanation.definitionFit: A cardsharp cheats at cards, a gambler working a swindle.

clue.text: Having a particular capacity to bond with opponent in camp

definitions.text: Having a particular capacity to bond

indicators.note: the word for opponent goes inside the word for camp

parts.note: a tent is the shelter of a camp
a rival is an opponent

explanation.surface: Someone at a campsite manages to bond with their rival.
explanation.definitionFit: A trivalent atom can form three chemical bonds, a specific bonding capacity in chemistry.

clue.text: Came across unruly youth around lively partygoers

indicators.note: the youth goes around the partygoers

parts.note: a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth of rebellious style
ravers are lively people who party hard

explanation.surface: A rowdy teenager came across among a crowd of partygoers.
explanation.definitionFit: Traversed means crossed over or travelled across.

clue.text: Villain concerned with what's needed to get hold of legacy

parts.note: re means about or concerning

parts.words: what's needed to get hold of legacy
parts.note: probate is the legal proving of a will before heirs receive their inheritance

explanation.surface: A rogue is interested only in the paperwork that unlocks an inheritance.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprobate is an unprincipled scoundrel, close to a rogue or villain.

clue.text: Place on examination gets enthusiastic approval

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place in addresses
an audit is an official examination of accounts

explanation.surface: An examination slot wins warm praise.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaudit is an expression of praise, enthusiastic approval.

clue.text: Rocky island exporting small breed of cattle

indicators.note: exporting sends something out, so the letter for small leaves the word

parts.note: a skerry is a small rocky island, chiefly Scottish
S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: A remote rocky island ships out a small breed of cattle.
explanation.walkthrough: Kerry is also an Irish county, which gives its name to the black dairy breed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kerry is a small black Irish breed of dairy cow.

clue.text: Sappers deal with withdrawal

parts.note: Sappers are the Royal Engineers, RE, of the British Army
to treat something is to deal with it

explanation.surface: Army engineers handle a military pull-back.
explanation.definitionFit: A retreat is a military withdrawal from a position.

clue.text: Half of liquid cleansers may be fake

indicators.note: half of the word is its first four letters

parts.note: shampoos are liquid soaps for hair

explanation.surface: Half the cleaning products on the shelf may be counterfeit.
explanation.definitionFit: A sham is a counterfeit or imposture, so something fake.

clue.text: For each soft drink has to run drinks machine

parts.note: per means for each
cola is a fizzy soft drink
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Every fizzy drink has to pass through a dispensing machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A percolator is a device that brews coffee, a machine for making drinks.

clue.text: Funny pear's not English

indicators.note: not means the letter for English is left out

parts.note: Comice is a variety of pear

explanation.surface: A pear that is not English tastes funny.
explanation.definitionFit: Comic as an adjective means amusing, a synonym for funny.

clue.text: Pipe up about title being brought up

indicators.note: in a down entry being brought up means read upwards

parts.note: re means about
Sir is a knight's title

explanation.surface: Someone speaks up about a title they were raised with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pipe up' looks like a verb, speak out, but is a noun: an upward pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A riser is a vertical pipe carrying water or gas upward in a building.

clue.text: Reluctant to talk about name for rabbit

indicators.note: the coy word goes about the letter for name

parts.note: coy means shy and reticent

explanation.surface: A shy pet is reluctant to talk about the name chosen for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Cony is an old word for a rabbit, also its fur.

clue.text: A trick nearly takes in couple? That's tough

indicators.note: the shortened trick takes the couple inside it
nearly the whole word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: a ruse is a trick
a duo is a pair or couple

explanation.surface: A puzzled solver finds a two-person trick a tough one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' cuts RUSE to RUS, which then 'takes in' DUO to give RDUOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Arduous means hard and demanding, a direct synonym of tough.

clue.text: Folly to finish back in service

indicators.note: the turned word goes inside the word for service

parts.note: Mass is the Catholic church service

indicators.note: back means the word is read the other way round

parts.note: the end is the finish

explanation.surface: It would be foolish to finish back at church for another service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns END into DNE, which goes 'in' MASS.
explanation.definitionFit: Madness and folly are both synonyms for foolishness or lack of sense.

clue.text: Shame about hard Concise

indicators.note: the word for shame goes about, around, the letter for hard

parts.note: as in 'what a shame', a pity
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A regret that a hard summary had to be so brief.
explanation.definitionFit: Pithy means brief and full of meaning, so concise.

clue.text: Speaker on platform reported one changing room that's shabby?

indicators.note: reported means as heard spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: an orator on a deck, a platform, read as deck orator

explanation.surface: A speaker on a stage is reported to want to spruce up a shabby room.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: a painter-and-decorator changes the look of a tired room.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorator renovates interiors, so is one who transforms a shabby room.
